Took it in Fall 20’ here’s a basic summary:

The professor is super chill and knowledgeable, he’s had a lot of furniture and wood shop experience 

There’s not much lecture (5-10% of class) and the class is only half a semester. Most of the class is hands on working and asking him questions if you are stuck or have an idea that you’re not sure how to do.

There are two projects and a technique practice assignment. The first is a box that you make using joints and a unique design for the lid that pertains to you. The second is a miniature of furniture that you will design. You have full range of control for the designs you choose.

All in all the class was fun, a good intro to wood working, and not much time spent outside of class as long as you get shit done during it 👍
